of.needed: whether the YAML shared_store_key_prefix setting for the boltdb-shipper or tsdb shipper is set to a value other than index/, and whether existing period configs using that index lack a matching path_prefix

consequence.statement: Operators who configured -boltdb.shipper.shared-store.key-prefix or -tsdb.shipper.shared-store.key-prefix (or the corresponding YAML setting) to a value other than index/ must set path_prefix on all existing period configs that use boltdb-shipper or tsdb as the index, to the previously configured value; this is presented as a required configuration step of the Loki 3.0.0 upgrade (the shared_store/shared_store_key_prefix shipper settings were removed).
consequence.remediation: Set path_prefix to the previously configured key-prefix value on every existing period config whose index is boltdb-shipper or tsdb.
